item.title: CyberPulse — When Gatekeepers Blink (2026-11-10)
item.dc:creator: Tushar Vartak
item.description: Multi-factor shortcuts, email scanner flaws, upgrade windows, and pipeline edges created real reach over the last seventy-two hours. A federated login bypass on a remote-access gateway, crafted attachments that led to root commands on a secure email appliance, an upgrade race in a major content platform added to the exploited catalog, and a critical pipeline vulnerability still being probed — plus fresh exploited-catalog entries — all point to one theme: fix the guardrails that decide who and what gets to act.
